_comment: Thinking and output token counts per model tier and task difficulty. Thinking tokens for 8B/medium (8400) are derived from DeepSeek-R1 paper (arXiv:2501.12948) Table 3: AIME 2024 avg output = 8741 tokens; final answer ~341 tokens. Larger model counts are proportional extrapolations from the same paper's scaling observations. KV cache per token from Llama-3.1 architecture specs (confirmed in arXiv:2404.14219); 32B class uses Qwen-32B GQA topology (64 layers, 8 KV heads, 128 head_dim, BF16). Verification scheme properties derived from arXiv:2505.13778 (CoIn), arXiv:2501.12948 (R1), and the existing Price of Trust analysis.

schemes.label: TEE full trace
schemes.note: Merkle commitment over all thinking tokens; storage scales with trace length

schemes.label: TEE output only
schemes.note: Standard deployment — attests answer, reasoning is trusted not proven

schemes.label: Optimistic replay
schemes.note: Stochastic reasoning can't be replayed — dispute game neutralized

schemes.label: ZK proof
schemes.note: Proof cost scales linearly with thinking tokens; ~1000x per 1k tokens

schemes.label: Proof-of-sampling
schemes.note: Audits output quality only; blind to scratchpad inflation
